description: __template: house style for generated dashboards (Atlas draft skill and canvas auto-drafts). NOT a dashboard: never pushed, never provisioned, skipped by _push_dashboard.py and the maintained-dashboard lists. CONTRACT: (1) datasource is only grafana-postgresql-datasource/supabase-postgres. (2) templating.list is the exact set of variables a draft may carry: workspace, allowed_devices (hidden), host, device_name, user_interface, environment, flag; copied from script-results.json and kpi-measurement.json, All-handling included, with one change: host/device_name/user_interface/environment carry allValue '__all' WITH the quotes (Grafana inserts a custom allValue RAW, so the quotes make $var read '__all'; All never expands to the option list) and panels write ('__all' IN ($var) OR col IN ($var) OR col IS NULL); flag uses allValue __ALL__. Atlas binds EVERY panel whose source has the column to the variable of the same meaning (so each dropdown works, filtered or not): host_name=$host, device_name=$device_name, userinterface_name=$user_interface, environment=$environment, flags=$flag; a value the user fixed becomes the variable's current value. (3) time, refresh, timezone, graphTooltip, schemaVersion, editable, annotations and links are copied as-is. (4) Grid is 24 columns: a draft uses 12-wide panels (24 when single) with the height of the timeseries example; per-type panel styling (fieldConfig.defaults, options) comes from the example panel of the same type. (5) Example panels show the query pattern: grafana_device_scope(...) CTE, team predicate (__TEAM_ID__ placeholder), $__timeFilter. A customer overlay replaces this file at the same path.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ads AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT device_key FROM grafana_device_scope(${__user.email:sqlstring}, ${__user.login:sqlstring}, ${workspace:sqlstring}))
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr.success) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "pass_rate"
FROM script_results sr
WHERE sr.team_id = '__TEAM_ID__'::uuid AND $__timeFilter(sr.started_at)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ads WHERE ads.device_key = '*' OR ads.device_key = sr.host_name || ':' || sr.device_name)
  AND ('__all' IN ($user_interface) OR sr.userinterface_name IN ($user_interface) OR sr.userinterface_name IS NULL)
  AND ('__all' IN ($host) OR sr.host_name IN ($host) OR sr.host_name IS NULL)
  AND ('__all' IN ($device_name) OR sr.device_name IN ($device_name) OR sr.device_name IS NULL)
  AND ('__all' IN ($environment) OR sr.environment IN ($environment))

targets.rawSql:
WITH ads AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT device_key FROM grafana_device_scope(${__user.email:sqlstring}, ${__user.login:sqlstring}, ${workspace:sqlstring}))
SELECT $__timeGroup(sr.started_at, '1d') AS "time", sr.device_name AS "metric",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr.success) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "value"
FROM script_results sr
WHERE sr.team_id = '__TEAM_ID__'::uuid AND $__timeFilter(sr.started_at)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ads WHERE ads.device_key = '*' OR ads.device_key = sr.host_name || ':' || sr.device_name)
  AND ('__all' IN ($user_interface) OR sr.userinterface_name IN ($user_interface) OR sr.userinterface_name IS NULL)
  AND ('__all' IN ($host) OR sr.host_name IN ($host) OR sr.host_name IS NULL)
  AND ('__all' IN ($device_name) OR sr.device_name IN ($device_name) OR sr.device_name IS NULL)
  AND ('__all' IN ($environment) OR sr.environment IN ($environment))
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

WITH ads AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT device_key FROM grafana_device_scope(${__user.email:sqlstring}, ${__user.login:sqlstring}, ${workspace:sqlstring}))
SELECT sr.script_name AS "script_name", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT sr.success) AS "failure_count"
FROM script_results sr
WHERE sr.team_id = '__TEAM_ID__'::uuid AND $__timeFilter(sr.started_at)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ads WHERE ads.device_key = '*' OR ads.device_key = sr.host_name || ':' || sr.device_name)
  AND ('__all' IN ($user_interface) OR sr.userinterface_name IN ($user_interface) OR sr.userinterface_name IS NULL)
  AND ('__all' IN ($host) OR sr.host_name IN ($host) OR sr.host_name IS NULL)
  AND ('__all' IN ($device_name) OR sr.device_name IN ($device_name) OR sr.device_name IS NULL)
  AND ('__all' IN ($environment) OR sr.environment IN ($environment))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 100
